source: NEA / MSE Singapore carbon tax trajectory — re-verified 2026-09-27 against MSE's Carbon Pricing Act page, NCCS, Climate Impact X, and the World Bank Carbon Pricing Dashboard. All legislated and indicative figures below (2024-25: $25, 2026-27: $45, 2030 target: $50-80) are unchanged and still current; official rates for 2028-2029 have still not been legislated/announced.
notes: Years 2028-2029 are linearly interpolated between the 2027 legislated rate and the 2030 indicative rate. Years after 2030 hold flat at the 2030 rate for the selected scenario. This is a modelling assumption, not a legislated figure.
